# Best Laptop Fit for a UK College Student

For **coding, note-taking, and light video editing** under **GBP 1,000**, the best balance is usually **performance + RAM + portability**. The strongest all-round pick here is the **Ryzen 7 15-inch model**, with the **i5 14-inch** as the safer portable alternative.

# Ranked Comparison for Coding, Notes, and Light Editing

| Rank | Laptop | Why it fits | Main tradeoff | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **15-inch, Ryzen 7, 16 GB, 1 TB, 1.8 kg, 8h, GBP 949** | Best CPU power, lots of storage, 16 GB RAM suits coding and editing | Heavier and shorter battery life | **Best overall** |
| 2 | **14-inch, Intel i5, 16 GB, 512 GB, 1.3 kg, 10h, GBP 899** | Good balance of portability, battery, and enough RAM | Less raw performance and storage than the Ryzen option | **Best portable choice** |
| 3 | **13-inch, Apple M2, 8 GB, 256 GB, 1.2 kg, 15h, GBP 999** | Excellent battery and very light | 8 GB RAM and 256 GB SSD are tight for coding + editing at this budget | **Best battery, weakest value** |

## Why They Rank This Way

### 1) 15-inch Ryzen 7
- **Best for coding**: Ryzen 7 gives the most headroom for IDEs, multitasking, containers, and browser tabs.
- **Best for light video editing**: 16 GB RAM plus **1 TB SSD** is the most comfortable setup here.
- **Downside**: At **1.8 kg** and **8 hours**, it is the least convenient for daily campus carry.

### 2) 14-inch Intel i5
- **Best balance**: Still has **16 GB RAM**, which matters more than flashy specs for student work.
- **More portable**: **1.3 kg** and **10-hour battery** make it easier for lectures, libraries, and commuting.
- **Downside**: The i5 is likely weaker than the Ryzen 7 for heavier multitasking and editing, and **512 GB** is decent but less generous.

### 3) 13-inch Apple M2
- **Best battery and portability**: **15 hours** and **1.2 kg** are excellent for all-day use.
- **Downside for your use case**: **8 GB RAM** and **256 GB SSD** are the biggest constraints. For coding plus note-taking plus editing, this is the most likely to feel cramped over time.
- **Best only if**: You strongly prioritize battery life and already work within lightweight apps and cloud storage.

## Best Choice by Priority

- **Best overall for your use case:** **Ryzen 7 15-inch**
- **Best for carrying around campus:** **Intel i5 14-inch**
- **Best battery life:** **Apple M2 13-inch**
